comment: The panel prints C4-E5 on the voice record input; Entrian's Acoustic Drums page calls it C4-D5, and the panel is followed here because ten white keys starting at C4 end on E5. The Reset and Run output jacks are not described in the manual, on the panel or in the plugin, so they are left untagged. The menu item names above are 'Phrase selection input:', 'Shared playhead:', 'Delay Clock/Reset/Run inputs', 'Set playhead to start marker on reset', 'Stop recording at end of song', 'Automatically add repeat markers when recording' and 'Save patch to use the free Entrian Player...'. The Light theme and Dark theme items are plugin-wide and cosmetic, so they get no line.
